proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding Shareholder Right to Act by Written Consent
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to permit shareholders holding the minimum votes needed to act to take action by written consent, including on any appropriate topic.
proposals.evidence: OUR BOARD UNANIMOUSLY RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THE SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding a Report on the Effects of the Use of Mandatory Arbitration
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a public report on how mandatory arbitration affects employees, harassment and discrimination prevalence, and employees' ability to seek redress.
proposals.evidence: OUR BOARD UNANIMOUSLY RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THE SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding Conversion to a Public Benefit Corporation
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to approve and submit to shareholders an amendment converting the company to a Public Benefit Corporation under Delaware law.
proposals.evidence: OUR BOARD UNANIMOUSLY RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THE SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding a Racial Equity Audit
proposals.proponent: Service Employees International Union Pension Plans Master Trust
proposals.topic_summary: Urges the board to oversee a racial equity audit analyzing the company's impacts on nonwhite stakeholders and communities of color, publicly disclosed.
proposals.evidence: OUR BOARD UNANIMOUSLY RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THE SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL.
